name: Timeline
description: A ferry operator's alerts, deploys, chat, tickets and agents' actions on one time axis, a lane per source, each event beside the event it answers and those that answer it.

collections.name: events
collections.one: one alert, deploy step, chat message, ticket message or agent action
collections.title: text

fields.name: time
fields.how: read in UTC, a deploys.csv time without an offset as UTC+1

fields.name: kind
fields.how: firing read as fired, a ticket's first message as opened

fields.name: actor
fields.from: by, user, From or the agent
fields.how: a login or chat id as chat/users.json names it

fields.name: service
fields.from: svc or service, the summary, tickets/index.csv
fields.how: a missing service from the summary's first word

fields.name: incident
fields.from: incident, an inc- channel or an INC number in the text
fields.how: a deploy's later steps take its incident

fields.name: answers
fields.from: resolves, deploy, thread_ts, ticket order, alert, ticket or via

fields.name: took
fields.how: seconds since the event it answers

tabs.name: Events
tabs.zoom: a click on the axis narrows to that time, on a lane to its source

tabs.name: Threads
tabs.zoom: a click on a speaker keeps their messages

accepts.means: the event on line <n>, selected in its list

units.means: one incident's events, the incident facet chosen
